description: This file defines utility functions and data structures for the beerocks namespace, including string manipulation, interface ID handling, bandwidth and frequency conversions, timestamp generation, and bitwise flag analysis.

classes.name: utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static helper functions for string, interface, bandwidth, timestamp, and flag operations within the beerocks namespace.

methods.name: IGNORE_UNUSED_VARIABLE
methods.description: Template function to mark variables as intentionally unused to avoid compiler warnings.

methods.name: zero_memory
methods.description: Template function to zero out memory of a variable with type safety.

methods.name: array_length
methods.description: Template function to get the length of a statically sized array.

methods.name: write_to_file
methods.description: Writes a string value to a specified file path.

methods.name: get_iface_type_from_string
methods.description: Converts a string to an interface type enum.

methods.name: get_iface_type_string
methods.description: Converts an interface type enum to its string representation.

methods.name: is_device_wireless
methods.description: Checks if a given interface type is wireless.

methods.name: get_default_ifname_prefix
methods.description: Returns the default prefix string for wireless interface names.

methods.name: get_default_ifname_separator
methods.description: Returns the default separator character for wireless VAP interface names.

methods.name: is_allowed_ifname_prefix
methods.description: Checks if an interface name prefix is allowed, either fully or partially.

methods.name: get_prefix_from_iface_string
methods.description: Extracts the prefix from an interface name string based on naming patterns.

methods.name: get_ids_from_iface_string
methods.description: Parses interface name string to extract interface and VAP IDs.

methods.name: get_iface_string_from_iface_vap_ids
methods.description: Constructs an interface string from interface and VAP IDs.

methods.name: convert_bandwidth_to_enum
methods.description: Converts an integer bandwidth value to an enum.

methods.name: convert_bandwidth_to_string
methods.description: Converts a bandwidth enum to its string representation.

methods.name: count_target_bandwidth
methods.description: Calculates the target bandwidth difference between two bandwidth enums.

methods.name: convert_frequency_type_to_string
methods.description: Converts a frequency type enum to string.

methods.name: convert_channel_ext_above_to_string
methods.description: Converts channel extension info to string.

methods.name: hex_dump
methods.description: Outputs a hex dump of a memory buffer with description.

methods.name: dump_buffer
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a buffer in hex.

methods.name: get_ISO_8601_timestamp_string
methods.description: Returns current timestamp as ISO 8601 string.

methods.name: compare_zwdfs_flag
methods.description: Checks if a specific ZWDFS flag is set in a bitwise flag.

methods.name: get_zwdfs_flags
methods.description: Extracts individual ZWDFS feature flags from a bitwise flag.

methods.name: get_zwdfs_string
methods.description: Returns a string describing supported ZWDFS features based on bitwise flag.
